name: Critical explosion risk from gas, workers, and hot work
description: Detects the classic compound hazard of high gas concentration, worker presence, and active hot work.
reason: Gas concentration exceeded the critical threshold while workers were present and hot work was active.

conditions.label: Gas concentration exceeded the critical threshold.
Workers are present in the affected zone.

recommendations.rationale: Immediate evacuation reduces the probability of worker exposure during ignition escalation.
Hot work must stop while the atmosphere remains hazardous.
Ventilation helps reduce accumulated flammable gas concentration.

name: Confined-space toxic exposure risk
description: Flags toxic exposure risk when gas is high during confined-space entry with workers present.
reason: Gas concentration is elevated during confined-space work with workers inside the area.

conditions.label: Gas concentration exceeded the confined-space safe limit.
Workers are inside the affected zone.

recommendations.rationale: Workers should be removed from the confined-space environment immediately.
A safety lead should control confined-space re-entry decisions.

name: Pressure and temperature escalation
description: Identifies process upset conditions consistent with thermal runaway or rupture escalation.
reason: Temperature and pressure are jointly elevated beyond the normal safe envelope.

recommendations.rationale: Controlled shutdown helps arrest thermal and pressure escalation.
Maintenance should inspect the affected process train before restart.

name: Maintenance ignition cascade
description: Detects elevated ignition and interaction risk during live maintenance with degraded equipment and workers nearby.
reason: Live maintenance on degraded equipment is raising the chance of an ignition or failure cascade.

conditions.label: Workers are exposed inside the zone.

recommendations.rationale: Stopping the affected equipment reduces the chance of a maintenance-related cascade.
Maintenance should review isolation and restore safe operating condition.

name: Overdue maintenance failure risk
description: Detects latent failure exposure where maintenance is overdue and equipment health is critically low.
reason: Overdue maintenance and poor equipment health are increasing failure probability.

recommendations.rationale: Immediate maintenance is needed to prevent equipment failure.

name: Weather-driven exposure risk
description: Detects rising exposure when adverse weather coincides with active permits and plant activity.
reason: Adverse weather is increasing plant exposure while live permit activity is ongoing.

conditions.label: At least one permit is currently active.

recommendations.rationale: Non-essential permit activity should pause during adverse weather.
Safety leadership should reassess field activity during the weather event.

name: Historical recurrence warning
description: Raises confidence and urgency when current conditions resemble repeated historical incidents.
reason: Current conditions resemble multiple historical incidents and a high-similarity benchmark pattern.

conditions.label: There is repeated incident history in this context.

recommendations.rationale: A recurring pattern requires management-level review and escalation.
